metas.name: Abar Hawa Bodol
metas.description: Two old friends, a rock star and an NRI, swap lives for fun, but the magical twist forces them to confront deep personal challenges, testing their bond and changing their perspectives on life and friendship.

metas.name: Bhanupriya Bhooter Hotel
metas.description: When ghosts come calling on guests at a hotel, all hell breaks loose.

metas.name: Bhuto Purbo
metas.description: On a stormy evening, two strangers arrive at Bibhutibhushan's ancestral home. As rain pours outside, the men exchange mysterious stories of a greedy woman's spirit bound to her jewels, a mystic caught between power and peace, and a conman whose perfect crime takes a dark turn.

metas.name: Bohurupi The Golden Daku HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Daktar Kaku
metas.description: A doctor and his son follow different ideals while working in their profession, which creates conflict. Whether the two give up their stubborn beliefs and unites for the greater cause of saving humankind will be seen in the film.

metas.name: DeSu7 HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Emperor vs Sarat Chandra HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
metas.description: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

metas.name: Nari Choritro Bejay Jotil
metas.description: During a Kali Puja night, Jhantu mysteriously gains the ability to hear women's inner thoughts, a power that first unsettles him but soon reveals the vulnerabilities and unspoken battles they carry.

metas.name: Phutaniganjer Mahesh
metas.description: Arunava Bagchi, a young government officer and thespian risks everything to cast a real bull, inspired by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's Mahesh, proving true art demands uncompromising passion and sacrifice.

metas.name: Saptadingar Guptodhon HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Terror Tales
metas.description: An anthology of horror.

metas.name: The Eken Kerala e Kurukshetra HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Ultorath
metas.description: Three generations confront conflict under one roof until one incident bridges their divide, proving patience and understanding can transform relationships.

metas.name: Vijaynagarer Hirey HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Anandi Meyeder Protishodher Larai
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Annapurna
metas.description: A mother, struggling with loneliness in London, defies expectations by starting her own food business, proving that it's never too late to chase your dreams - even when your family stands in the way.

metas.name: Babu Shona
metas.description: A kidnapper and a crafty thief get tangled in a chaotic kidnapping mission in London, but their unlikely romance and hilarious schemes lead to unexpected outcomes for everyone involved.

metas.name: Bhaggyolokkhi
metas.description: A married couple discover a dead body with a suitcase of cash in their house and get entangled in a web of crime involving politicians, police and cold-blooded killers. Can they dispose of the corpse and get out of this mess?

metas.name: Bramhaarjun
metas.description: A Souvik Dey film.

metas.name: Chandrabindoo
metas.description: A grieving young man and a widow find solace in each other as they navigate loss, while the spirits of their loved ones linger, offering one last chance of closure before moving on.

metas.name: Devi Chowdhurani
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of British colonial rule, Devi Chowdhurani tells the untold story of India's first female freedom fighter. From a humble villager to a fearless rebel, she rises against oppression with the support of Hindu monks, leading the first armed revolution against the British East India Company. A tale of courage, sacrifice, and resilience, this historical epic brings to life a forgotten chapter of India's fight for freedom.

metas.name: Dhumketu
metas.description: Megh is a married person, who works as manager of a tea estate in North Sikkim. In a certain crisis he became jobless and struggles to make ends problems of his life because there are not many options for livelihood around in the hills. He fights to bring back joy into his family's life.

metas.name: Grihapravesh
metas.description: In a fading North Calcutta Rajbari, Titli clings to routine after her husband Shaon vanishes. As Durga Puja nears, Megh arrives, an unexpected guest who brings warmth and a painful revel of thought. Amid rituals and memories, unspoken grief surfaces, stirring buried emotions, silent longing, and the ache of unfinished stories.

metas.name: Haati Haati Paa Paa
metas.description: A daughter balances caring for her aging father with her own life, revealing generational bonds and family tensions in contemporary society.

metas.name: Jhor HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Killbill Society
metas.description: As Ananda Kar returns, now as Mrityunjay Kar, truth and destiny collide in a journey of love, healing, and purpose. With its iconic music and unexpected twists, Killbill Society is set to redefine `existence` through its compelling story.

metas.name: Kirtaner Por Kirtan
metas.description: Abinash, his son Arup, and daughter-in-law Monimala continue their constant bickering even after shifting to a new flat, with Arup endlessly stuck between them. When circumstances force them to find another home, Abinash revisits their old house only to discover a tenant now lives there. What follows is a chain of hilarious misunderstandings and escalating family drama, leaving their future up in the air.

metas.name: Lawho Gouranger Naam Rey
metas.description: Lawho Gouranger Naam Rey intertwines three timelines from Mahaprabhu's divine era to colonial theatre and a modern film set.

metas.name: Madam Sengupta
metas.description: A famed cartoonist's search for her daughter's killer unravels a sinister trail of poetic murders, leading back to her estranged ex-husband, whose forbidden play threatens to expose Kolkata's darkest secrets.

metas.name: Mrigaya The Hunt
metas.description: The gruesome death of a sex worker at Kolkata's Sonagachi brings four very unlikely cops together for the inquiry. What follows is a hunt for the criminal, where the lines between good and evil blur.

metas.name: Oporichito
metas.description: After an accident a man has lost his memory. However, he feels a conspiracy is brewing around him. His suspicion grows and he can’t even trust his colleagues, friends, and even police officers.

metas.name: Pokkhirajer Dim
metas.description: A student finds a mysterious stone at a temple and turns to his quirky teacher for help, unleashing supernatural forces that change their lives.

metas.name: Projapati 2
metas.description: Joy lives in London with his daughter. He wants his parents to stay with them in London, but his father, who runs a hotel in Kolkata, refuses to go to London.

metas.name: Raas
metas.description: Once, the Chakrabortys of Manikpur were a thriving family of 34, united in laughter, meals, and the grand celebration of Raas. In the 90s, Rajat left for Kolkata to chase his ambitions, leaving behind his wife Annapurna and son Somnath. Raised among his cousins, Somnath grew closer to his grandmother than his mother. When he was twelve, Annapurna succumbed to a terminal illness. Rajat, unaware until his return, was consumed by anger and left Manikpur with his son, vowing never to return.

metas.name: Rabindra Kabya Rahasya
metas.description: A modern-day poet uncovers a dark conspiracy surrounding a lost manuscript of Rabindranath Tagore, leading to a trail of murders, betrayal and a race to protect Indias cultural legacy.

metas.name: Raghu Dakat HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Raktabeej 2
metas.description: Months after the failed assassination attempt on President Animesh Chatterjee, investigator Pankaj Sinha and SP Sanjukta Mitra uncover a deadly plot, Mission M2, led by Munir Alam.

metas.name: Ranna Baati
metas.description: In the bustling, nostalgic lanes of North Kolkata, Sumit Dasgupta, a 40-year-old software engineer, lives a routine-driven life with his teenage daughter, Mohor. Ever since his wife, Supriya, passed away unexpectedly a year ago, Sumit has been struggling to balance his demanding job and single parenthood.

metas.name: Saralakkha Holmes
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Sharthopor HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Shotyi Bole Shotyi Kichhu Nei
metas.description: Twelve jury members debate fiercely over a murder trial. Only one juror is convinced that the convict is not guilty of the crime and he tries to convince the rest that the boy is innocent.

metas.name: Sonar Kellay Jawker Dhan
metas.description: The adventure that began in Sonar Kella continues. Haunted by visions of a hidden treasure, Mukul Dhars fate is on the line. As danger closes in, Bimal, Rubi, and Kumar set off on a thrilling journey through the secrets of Jaisalmer Fort. Chasing riddles, uncovering legends, and seeking a mythical stone, they venture into a world that could change their lives forever.

metas.name: Tobu Bhalobashi
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Turuper Tass
metas.description: Debjit Hazra's directorial debut.

metas.name: Athhoi
metas.description: A contemporary retelling of William Shakespeare's timeless tragedy Othello, exploring the intricacies of human emotions and the consequences of unchecked manipulation, all within a Bengali context.

metas.name: Babli
metas.description: Babli, a chubby straight-spoken, prideful, sweet girl is escorted by Abhirup Sen, a handsome, soft-spoken, humble guy on her journey from Imphal to Dimapur. At Kolkata airport, Babli meets her school friend Jhuma Bose, a smart and attractive air hostess who has fallen for Abhirup. Will Babli and Abhi ever get together?

metas.name: Bohurupi
metas.description: A mysterious dacoit is on the run. A supercop gets involved with him in a cat and mouse chase.

metas.name: Boomerang
metas.description: After losing her job, a flailing millennial is forced to move back into her childhood bedroom and navigate life with her dysfunctional parents. Determined to take on a lover, she re-connects with a middle school crush.

metas.name: Chaalchitra Ekhon
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Jajabara 2 0
metas.description: When two strangers meet by a fluke they open up about their criminal past. While one retains the crime, the other seeks redemption.

metas.name: Khadaan
metas.description: Shyam comes from the remote areas of Purulia to work as a laborer in the coal mines of the Damodar Valley. The story of Mohan and Shyam will proceed with their rise, reckoning of friendship.

metas.name: Oti Uttam
metas.description: The film narrates the story of a PhD scholar, who is pursuing his research on Uttam Kumar. After being rejected by the girl he likes romantically, he decides to bring the spirit of the legendary actor back with the help of his grandson.

metas.name: Pariah Volume 1
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Robin's Kitchen
metas.description: Another directorial feature by Shuvro Jyoti Basak Bappa.

metas.name: Sentimentaaal
metas.description: Police officer Suryaa Roy, gets transferred to Raghunathpur where local politician Rudrani Chowdhury runs many illegal businesses. When they come at loggerheads, can Suryaa save his family and the people of Raghunathpur?

metas.name: Shontaan
metas.description: What happens when a devoted father is rejected by the son he raised? As he seeks justice in court, will the family heal, or will the divide grow deeper?

metas.name: Shri Swapankumarer Badami Hyenar Kobole
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Tekka
metas.description: Tekka is the story of Iqlakh, a janitor who has lost his job and is out to get it back by holding a schoolgirl hostage in a building. ACP Maya comes in, a woman who is trying to conceive. Add to the mix a young journalist pair, Brishti and Tintin, and we have a sentimental thriller in an office building spanning 48 hours, full of melodrama.

metas.name: Abar Bibaho Obhijaan
metas.description: On being released from jails, Bullet Singh meets Anupam and Rajat to inform him that a fellow prisoner has gifted him a Rs. 100 crores worth Hotel, which he wants to share with them. They soon realize it's a trap. Can they get out of it?

metas.name: Angshuman MBA
metas.description: Friends often mock ‘Angshuman’ about the family business. So he will do something new with a master’s degree in commerce. He also started a break-up company accordingly! This organization helps to end the long-running conflict between boyfriend and girlfriend or husband and wife. That is, it causes separation!

metas.name: Archier Gallery
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Ardhangini
metas.description: After Suman suffers an accident, the two women in his life - Meghna, the wife, and Shubhra, the ex-wife - are compelled to meet each other. Ardhangini revolves around the awkward emotional duel between the two wives - past and present - in a time of personal crisis.

metas.name: Bagha Jatin
metas.description: Jatindranath Mukherjee is an Indian independence activist. He is the principal leader of the Jugantar party that is the central association of revolutionary independence activists in Bengal.

metas.name: Bhoy
metas.description: Ayan, a swimming coach, lives with his ailing mother and an autistic sister, Anu. His life takes a drastic turn when he is entrapped in a false case by his greedy uncle, who is after the family's property.

metas.name: Biye Bibhrat
metas.description: Shakya, a star singer yet tired of several failed relationships, decides to get hitched to a bride his mother has selected for him. But drama ensues, when Chandramauli, the bride's former boyfriend, tries to win her over.

metas.name: Bogla Mama
metas.description: Set in the backdrop of the late 1980s, Bogla Charan Bhattacharya is a funny, witty, middle aged theatre fanatic who is loved by the entire town for his problem-solving skills. Bogla Charan along with his band of rugged young adults dive into hilarious adventures only to create further inconveniences. But in the end, Bogla's charm and cleverness always saves the day.

metas.name: Byomkesh O Durgo Rahasya
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Cheeni 2
metas.description: Mishti, a housewife, is constantly ignored by her husband and children. And Cheeni is full of life and has big dreams. When the path between Mishti and Cheeni collides, they embark on a journey of self-discovery together.

metas.name: Chengiz
metas.description: The movie revolves around Chengiz, an underworld mafia from the 1970s to the mid-90s that ruled the streets of Calcutta.

metas.name: Daal Baati Churma
metas.description: BK Entertainment's first venture 'Daal Bati Churma (Chocchori)' stars actor-producers Bonny Sengupta as a Rajasthani living in North Kolkata and Koushani Mukherjee as a South Kolkata-based Bengali.

metas.name: Dasham Avatar
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Datta
metas.description: Based on Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's classic 'Datta', Banamali proposes his daughter Bijoya's hand to his childhood friend's son, Narendra. But, Bijoya is attracted to Bilas and has always been skeptical about Narendra. However, when Bijoya meets Narendra, her feelings take a turn towards the unexpected.

metas.name: Dawshom Awbotaar
metas.description: What happens when a serial killer terrorizes the city of Kolkata by mirroring the mythological stories of Vishnu and his ten avatars in his killing methods? A prequel crossover of Baishe Srabon and Vinci Da.

metas.name: Dilkhush
metas.description: Dilkhush follows the story of eight individuals who find themselves in the loop of urban melancholy. Discovering love with the help of AI makes their ordinary lives extraordinary.

metas.name: Doctor Bakshi
metas.description: After serving a jail sentence, Doctor Bakshi resumes his methods of seeking justice.

metas.name: Fatafati
metas.description: Phullora Bhaduri, a tailor from the suburbs with a gifted sense of design, is ridiculed for being on the heavier side. Can she become a fashion influencer despite the odds?

metas.name: Ghore Pherar Gaan
metas.description: Tora, a music enthusiast, shifts to London after her marriage. She finds it hard to grapple with the high-society lifestyle thrust upon her by her mother-in-law, while she desperately tries to impress her cold and distant husband, Ribhu. A chance meeting with a talented Indian musician, Imran, turns her life around and the two are drawn to each other by their shared passion for country music and a tattered bond with their respective motherlands.

metas.name: Jai Kali Kalkattawali
metas.description: A coveted idol of Goddess Kali, worth crores, gets stolen from a temple on the outskirts of Kolkata. While several parties, and the police, are looking for the idol, will it end up in the right place?

metas.name: Jongole Mitin Mashi
metas.description: Jongole Mitin Mashi is based on a story of anti-poaching of elephants and depicts the fight of Mitin against the enemies of the forest. Sequel to the 2019 detective thriller Mitin Mashi.

metas.name: Kaberi Antardhan
metas.description: Arghya Sen who takes Mrinmoy's son Amartya's art classes, visits their house when the mystery unfolds. On his arrival, he learns that not only has Mrinmoy been killed, but Kaberi Bhattacharya, Mrinmoy's beautiful sister, is also missing.

metas.name: Kabuliwala
metas.description: When Arjun, a 8-year-old-boy, expresses his desire to switch from daily car rides with his grandfather, Mr. Chaturvedi, to taking the school bus with his friends, Mr. Chaturvedi goes through an internal crisis leaving him feeling unwanted and lonely.

metas.name: Kirtan
metas.description: Kirtan is the story of a father-in-law and daughter-in-law who disagree about leaving their ancestral home and shifting into a new apartment.

metas.name: Love Marriage
metas.description: Dipu is in love with Shaon but he is unable to marry her because his father is against love marriage. However, Dipu manages to convince his father to go to Shaon's place but it turns out that Shaon's mother was Dipu's father's ex-girlfriend. What will happen next? Will Dipu and Shaon get married?

metas.name: Nikhonj The Search Begins
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Pradhan
metas.description: Deepak Pradhan, a young police officer, gets transferred to North Bengal where his junior officers are involved in corrupt practices. When disturbing events from the past start to surface and the pressure builds, will Deepak be able to hold on to his principles to save his integrity and loved ones?

metas.name: Raktabeej
metas.description: A thriller revolving around a sudden blast in a Khagragarh firecracker unit, some 70 km away from then president of India's house, ahead of Durga Puja in 2014. Is there more than meets the eye?

metas.name: Shohorer Ushnotomo Din E
metas.description: Kolkata natives Ritoban and Anindita rekindle their college romance after years apart. Amidst the city's timeless essence, they grapple with sacrificing dreams for love or love for dreams.

metas.name: Tenida and Company
metas.description: Based on Narayan Gangopadhyay's Iconic character "Tenida". Bhajahari Mukherjee AKA Tenida, Kyabla, Pyala and Habul have grown a bit older, They visit Darjeeling for a holiday where they fall into serious trouble. One scientist Satkari Santra asks them for help to protect his valuable formula from a Japanese spy Kagamachi. Satkari invites Tenida and his associates in his residence, Jhau Bungalow, but Kyabla finds Satkari himself is very misleading person. They try to reveal the mystery behind Satkari's story. Will they survive from the danger?

metas.name: The Eken Ruddhaswas Rajasthan
metas.description: While Ekendra Sen was enjoying his vacation in colourful Rajasthan with Bapi and Pramatha, suddenly a professor of archaeology at Oxford University, Shatadru Ghosh, informs Eken about his suspicion on a particular idol he had seen in London went missing. Eken begins his investigation with his two confidantes, where all the mystery facts will baffle him while constantly challenging his intelligence and observation skills. What happens when the situation gets out of hand after finding fake artefacts at the Jaisalmer Museum?

metas.name: #Homecoming
metas.description: A group of "friends" and "misfits", who had formed a popular yet short-lived youth theatre group, reunite for the first time after seven years on an eventful Durga Pujo night at their old rehearsal space, a bungalow which is about to be converted into Kolkata's first five-star heritage hotel by the Ganges.

metas.name: 812 Binay Badal Dinesh
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: A Holy Conspiracy
metas.description: A science teacher in a Christian missionary school is suspended and imprisoned as he refuses to teach the Bible’s Genesis before Darwinian Evolution. As two stalwarts, Reverend Basanta Kumar Chatterjee and Anton De Souza, face each other in court for the trial, a Hindu fundamentalist politician uses the issue for his gain

metas.name: Ajker Shortcut
metas.description: The story takes off when Bishu, a slum dweller, and Abesh, a wanna-be poet, feel shaken after witnessing suicide of a homeless person on a busy road of Kolkata.

metas.name: Akash ongshoto meghla
metas.description: The film connects apparently disconnected stories of two men who have lost their way of life as a consequence of unexpected lockout or closure of factory.

metas.name: Amrapali
metas.description: Amrapali follows the story of three young friends—Ayan, Payel, and Kabir—who navigate love, life, and friendship amidst the political drama in their village, Rajchandrapur.

metas.name: Ananta (The Eternal)
metas.description: A jobless unambitious and lonely Suvo and a lonely teacher Mistu live in the same locality. In Suvo`s imagination, they meet and talk every day. But when she gets married to Somnath, he is hurt. Believing their meetings were true, he still waits for her in his dream and reality. In reality, she hangs herself.

metas.name: Aparajito
metas.description: A young filmmaker prepares for the debut of his first feature film.

metas.name: Baba Baby O
metas.description: Meghroddur, a single father in his 40s, falls for Brishti.

metas.name: Ballabhpurer Roopkotha
metas.description: The almost crumbling Rajbari of Ballabhpur only has two men living — the last descendant of Ray dynasty, Bhupati Ray, and his inherited menial, Manohar. Both the dwellers are overburdened with heavy debts and seek no hope of betterment until one day, Kolkata's soap King, Mr. Haldar, plans buying the property. Can Bhupati Ray and Manohar succeed in selling it?
